taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-10, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104.3 | 6.31 | 6.31
2 | 416.7 | 17.57 | 23.88
3 | 264.5 | 2.29 | 26.17
4 | 856.9 | 2.63 | 28.80
5 | 641.5 | 26.88 | 55.68
6 | 7698.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-10, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-10 (Area T)**

**Layer Sequence Summary:**
* **Layer 1 (0–6.31 m):** 104.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, topsoil/weathered zone.
* **Layer 2 (6.31–23.88 m):** 416.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, semi-resistive layer.
* **Layer 3 (23.88–26.17 m):** 264.5 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, conductive horizon.
* **Layer 4 (26.17–28.80 m):** 856.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, resistive band.
* **Layer 5 (28.80–55.68 m):** 641.5 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thick intermediate zone.
* **Layer 6 (>55.68 m):** 7698.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, fresh resistive basement.

**Curve Type Assessment:**
The interpreted sounding exhibits alternating resistivity variations ($r_1 < r_2 > r_3 < r_4 > r_5 < r_6$). The 4-segment triplet progression yields K ($1\text{-}2\text{-}3$), H ($2\text{-}3\text{-}4$), K ($3\text{-}4\text{-}5$), and H ($4\text{-}5\text{-}6$), resulting in a **KHKH-type** curve. The archival A-type classification does not fit these layer values and is erroneous.

{"curve_type_stated": "KHKH", "label_issue_flagged": true}
